special_ground: coastal sage scrub / brush along Sand Canyon Wash (front nine) and on the canyon slopes (back nine): penalty area or general area unknown (local rules not found)
wetlands on the front nine and in Shady Canyon (back nine)
water: Sand Canyon Reservoir (IRWD recycled-water storage, 35 acres per the club, 51 acres at full pool; drawn down every autumn): five back-nine holes around it, water left of 10. Sand Canyon Wash, a brush-filled channel along many front-nine holes (creek beyond the trees left of 6). Wetlands. Hole 18: a brook about 30 yd short of the green and a waterfall right of the fairway (a recirculating feature fed from the reservoir). Standing default: all red.
